changelog:
Version 7.8.98

Fixed

  • The page cache no longer stores pages that are marked private or that set a login, cart or comment cookie.
  • Updates are refused when the downloaded package is not the newer version that was announced.
  • Restoring original images no longer removes WebP/AVIF files created by another image plugin.
  • The "Keep after uninstall" choice is respected when a preset is applied.
  • Font Awesome styles inlined by the plugin follow file updates immediately.
